questions.prompt: You are about to insert a urinary catheter. Which moment is this?

choices.text: Moment 2 — before a clean / aseptic procedure

questions.explain: A catheter is an aseptic procedure — clean right before it.

questions.prompt: You adjusted the IV pump but did not touch the patient. Do you need to clean your hands?
questions.explain: The pump is in the patient zone — moment 5.
